tasks.title: Switch issue diff API to base-vs-head worktree comparison
tasks.description: Update `GET /api/issues/:number/diff` to build its git diff range with two-argument base/head comparison instead of three-dot merge-base comparison. Keep the existing response shape, availability handling, `--numstat` summary generation, and per-file diff parsing, but ensure both summary and patch output come from the same corrected diff range.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/issues/:number/diff` returns `available: true`, `base`, `head`, summary counts, and per-file unified diff content using `git diff <baseBranch> <branchName>` semantics
For a branch that has merged the base branch forward, the diff response excludes files that are already present on both base and head
`--numstat` additions, deletions, and filesChanged counts stay aligned with the returned file diff list
tasks.notes: Do not change commit-list or commit-diff endpoints in this task.

tasks.title: Align `mo issue diff` with the API diff semantics
tasks.description: Update the `mo issue diff <number>` command to use the same two-argument base/head diff semantics as the API. This keeps terminal review output consistent with the primary Files changed review surface without changing the command's existing error handling or data-loading flow.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue diff <number>` runs `git diff <baseBranch> <branchName>` instead of three-dot syntax
For the same issue branch, CLI diff output matches the cleaned file set shown by the API-backed review surface
Existing unknown-revision and missing-worktree error behavior remains unchanged
tasks.notes: Keep this task scoped to issue-level file diff behavior only.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage for merge-forward issue diff review
tasks.description: Add or update focused tests covering an issue branch that merges the base branch before adding issue-specific changes, so the corrected two-dot diff behavior is locked in. Verify both the API diff payload and the CLI-facing behavior that depends on the same comparison semantics, while leaving commit endpoints untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated tests cover a merge-forward branch history where base changes are present on both branches and are excluded from issue-level file diff results
Automated tests verify the diff summary and per-file patch set stay consistent after the range change
Automated tests confirm commit diff behavior is unchanged or not broadened by this fix
tasks.output: packages/cli/tests/review-surface.test.ts and related CLI diff regression coverage
tasks.notes: Prefer extending existing review-surface and CLI command tests rather than creating a new end-to-end harness.
